name: Omani Euro Food Industries SAOG
description: Omani Euro Food Industries SAOG, established in 1997 with commercial operations since 2001, operates a 7,500 m² food manufacturing plant in Sohar (4,000 tons/year capacity) producing infant cereals, milk powders, rusks, biscuits, cake mixes, breadcrumbs, and nutritional drinks (Nutrifast and Trimfast). The company pursues a dual commercial strategy pairing its proprietary Omani brand Mother's Choice with private-label contract manufacturing for regional and international partners across Oman, Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Iraq, and wider GCC markets. In 9M 2026, total sales stabilized at OMR 0.528 million (with Q3 sales climbing 17% YoY to OMR 0.212 million) as a 42% surge in contract manufacturing offset distributor-transition softness in Mother's Choice.
highlights: Grew contract-manufacturing revenue 42% YoY to OMR 0.255 million in 9M 2026 (48.3% of total sales) with 100% order compliance, including a first Saudi private-label production run.
Rebounded in Q3 2026 with total sales up 17% YoY to OMR 0.212 million following new and returning export shipments to Saudi Arabia (under a new distributor), Yemen, and Iraq.
FY2025 Financial Snapshot: Revenue of OMR 746.0K and Net Profit of -OMR 594.0K (Total Assets: OMR 2.53M).
Ownership Registry (mcd.om): 329 registered shareholders • Omani 81.3% | GCC 18.5% | Foreign & Arab 0.2% (2 disclosed 5%+ holders).
